title: GPT4Video: A Unified Multimodal Large Language Model for Instruction-Followed Understanding and Safety-Aware Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's safety and rejection rate of inappropriate queries using a custom multimodal benchmark for NSFW (Not Safe For Work) content, as well as a subset of the RealToxicityPrompts dataset focused specifically on 'sexually_explicit' and 'severe_toxicity' categories.
